summary: Failed (timeout): The click event likely triggered a slow or blocked handler on the host page, causing the automation watchdog to time out. Common hosting-side causes are a modal-opening handler that performs heavy rendering, synchronous computation, or blocking network requests before acknowledging the click, or an overlay/z-index issue that prevents the button from being interacted with reliably. This makes the browser action hang until the 15s watchdog expires. Underlying error: Test failed … Target: environment default (http://localhost:5173).
